title: Pudhiya Geethai
desc: A jovial young man, Sarathy, is unaware of a prophecy predicting his death at the age of twenty-seven. Later, when a land deal turns sour, he clashes with the powerful Reddiyar.

title: Sanga Thamizhan
desc: Murugan, a happy-go-lucky young man, falls in love with the daughter of Sanjay, an industrialist. However, trouble arises when Sanjay notices that Murugan looks like a figure from his dark past.

title: Kanthaswamy
desc: Kanthaswamy, a CBI officer, conceals his identity by wearing a mask, in order to fight corruption and help people who need justice.

title: Vaanam
desc: The lives of five individuals living in different places converge at a point, resulting in the transformation of their persona and purpose.

title: Neer Nilam Neruppu
desc: Chellama forces her sister to marry her husband, Kuppan, because she is unable to conceive. But after they are blessed with a child, Kuppan gets attracted to another woman, Rajathi.

title: Nenjathai Kiladhae
desc: Anandhi, a documentary filmmaker with a keen eye for story, finds herself captivated by Vasanth, a charismatic young man with a penchant for the bizarre.

title: Teleshopping
desc: Learn about a wide selection of products and take advantage of a convenient method of shopping. A show for those who love to shop from the comforts of their home.

title: Joot Are You Ready
desc: Easwaran, a young man from a small village, and his ailing father move in with his older brother in Chennai. However, things become complicated when he gets embroiled with local gangsters.
